macOS 15 is the cross-architecture support floor; runner-image updates may refresh current hosts but must not silently drop the floor.
Python 3.11.0 is the literal source floor; Renovate must not move even its patch version and turn this into a current-3.11 test.

Automerge patch, minor, and digest updates. Every dep that ships or builds the tool is exercised by a CI job (shellcheck / python / build / integration) and Renovate only automerges on green, so a breaking bump fails the PR before it can merge. Major updates, and the exceptions below, are reviewed by hand.
These actions run ONLY inside the release/publish workflows, which ci.yml's push checks don't exercise, so their minor + major bumps get a human review (patch + digest still automerge).
Valetudo is the firmware flashed to the robot. Renovate surfaces version bumps, but never automerges them because the release digests must be reviewed and updated with the version.
prBodyNotes: Update all `VALETUDO_SHA256` entries in `dreame_valetudo/constants.py` from the new release asset digests before merging.

packageRules.description: sunxi-tools is the FEL transport compiled into every release and used against the robot's boot ROM, so every upstream commit requires human review.
prBodyNotes: Review the upstream sunxi-tools commit before merging; every build channel reads this SHA from `dreame_valetudo/constants.py`.

packageRules.description: The macOS package compiles and signs tmux from its release tarball, whose digest must move with the version.
prBodyNotes: Update `TMUX_SHA256` in `dreame_valetudo/constants.py` from the new release tarball before merging.

packageRules.description: CPython is frozen into the bundle, and every version change requires the matching source checksum; a new minor also changes the Homebrew dependency.
prBodyNotes: Update `BUNDLE_PYTHON_SHA256` from the matching python.org source tarball. A CPython minor bump must also update `depends_on "python@3.x"` in `packaging/homebrew/*.rb` by hand.

packageRules.description: The manylinux builders define the shipped glibc ABI; every digest change requires the source-version and embedded-ELF audits.
